The bug: the `while true do` loop never yields (no `task.wait()`), so it blocks the server thread and freezes Studio.

```luau
local part = workspace.Beacon
while true do
	part.Transparency = 1 - part.Transparency
	task.wait(0.5)
end
```

The bug is that `hit.Parent` may be nil (or lack a Humanoid) when non-character parts touch the brick, causing an attempt to index nil.

```luau
local brick = script.Parent
brick.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local humanoid = hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end)
```

The bug: `=` is the assignment operator; Luau requires `==` for equality comparison in conditions.

```luau
local score = 10
if score == 10 then
	print("perfect score")
end
```

The bug is using `+` (arithmetic addition) instead of `..` (concatenation) to join the string and number.

```luau
local score = 42
print("Score: " .. score)
```

The loop never runs because the default step is +1, so starting at 10 and ending at 1 never satisfies the condition — you need a step of -1.

```luau
for i = 10, 1, -1 do
	print(i)
	task.wait(1)
end
```
